title: A Theory of Quasi-Experimental Evaluation of School Quality
eligible_reason: Theory paper on whether lottery-based school-choice research designs (first-choice design, qualification instrument) extract conditionally random assignment under deferred-acceptance-type mechanisms. No difference-in-differences, no panel treatment adoption. The de Chaisemartin flag comes from a citation to de Chaisemartin and Behaghel (2017) on instruments with random waitlists.
design_notes: Only empirical content is an illustration using Denver Public Schools assignment data to simulate assignment probabilities (Figure 1, Table 2). No regression-based causal estimates.
screener_notes: False positive from the full-text 'de Chaisemartin' hit. Text screened is the HCEO working paper 2020-085 (June 2020).
